name: Sub-counties of Kenya (KNBS 2019 census)
source: KNBS, 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census Volume I: Population by County and Sub-County, Table 2.5
notes: Census (national-government administrative) sub-counties as enumerated in the 2019 census; not a Ministry of Interior gazette list, and later gazetted new sub-counties are not reflected. KNBS publishes no sub-county codes, so code is blank. 12 census special areas marked * in the source (forests / national parks, e.g. Mt. Kenya Forest, Aberdare National Park) are excluded. Validation: for every county the parsed sub-county totals (incl. special areas) sum exactly to the county total. Names as printed by KNBS, including its disambiguated forms (Samburu-Kwale, Kimilili-Bungoma).
